title: Sequencing: supplier presentations
bodyMd:
Five supplier proposals are presented consecutively to a purchasing team. Each proposal appears once.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Arden, Bex, Corin, Daro, Eris.

- Bex must be in position 3.
- Eris must precede Arden.
- Exactly 1 other item must occur between Corin and Daro.
